top_findings.title: MCP server never flushes stdout — JSON-RPC handshake times out, server unusable by any real client
top_findings.evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccerMCP/main.swift:23 emits every reply with print(output); grep across all of Sources/ finds no fflush/setvbuf/setbuf/FileHandle.standardOutput. Swift's print uses libc block-buffering when stdout is a pipe (every MCP client), so initialize/tools/list replies sit in the buffer while the process blocks on readLine() (main.swift:15). Reproduced against the release binary: pipe held open -> 0 replies in 6s; the 2 replies flush only after stdin closes and the process exits. Independently confirmed by _runtime.json ('no reply to tools/list within 30s', ok=false) and _factual.json (score 0.0).
top_findings.suggestion: Add fflush(stdout) after each print(output) at main.swift:23, or setvbuf(stdout, nil, _IONBF, 0) at startup. Also add a JSON-RPC-over-stdio integration test (unit tests call SoccerRepository directly and never exercise the transport).
